sources.snippet: 💃🏻 DWPose 💃🏻 This repository is the official implementation of the Effective Whole-body Pose Estimation with Two-stages Distillation. Our code is based on MMPose and ControlNet. ⚔️ We release a series of models named DWPose with different sizes, from tiny to large, for human whole-body pose estimation.

sources.title: IDEA-Research/DWPose | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Conclusion DWPose represents an effective approach to whole-body pose estimation through its innovative two-stage distillation methodology. The system provides multiple model variants for different computational constraints, supports both PyTorch and ONNX inference, and integrates seamlessly with ControlNet for AI image generation applications.
